description_en: Issues reverse access routes to connected instances when the advanced reverse access feature is enabled
description_zh: 开启了反向访问高级特性场景下，针对连接实例下发反向访问路由
name: CreateIoTCloudConnectorBackhaulRoute

parameters.help_en: The ID of the 5G Cloud Connector instance
parameters.name: wireless_cloud_connector_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the network connectivity
parameters.name: net_link_id

parameters.help_en:
Ensures the idempotence of the request. You can generate the value from your client to ensure that the value is unique across different requests. The value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.
If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run on the request. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run and does not create the instance group. The system checks whether required parameters are specified, the request format is valid, and service limits are met. If the request fails the check, an error is returned. If the request passes the check, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): performs a regular request. If the request passes the check, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会创建实例组。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run
